info.title: AREX Public API
info.description: JSON fields and error codes use snake_case; durations carry units and timestamps use _at. Errors use {error:{code,message,retryable,request_id,param?}}. retryable means a transient failure.

post.description: Find web pages matching a query. Returns up to limit ranked results, each with a title, URL, and optional snippet and published_at timestamp, for locating specific pages, documentation, or candidate sources; optional published_after and published_before bound publication time.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A matching value is echoed; invalid values are replaced by a UUID.

post.description: Extract clean Markdown text and metadata from one public HTTP(S) page. content holds at most max_characters and truncated reports whether more exists; title, published_at and image URLs are included when known. tier is auto or flex (flex may take longer); livecrawl forces a fresh crawl instead of cached content.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A matching value is echoed; invalid values are replaced by a UUID.

post.description: Start a Research Run that researches a natural-language query across multiple web sources and returns a synthesized answer with cited sources (well-suited for open-ended, comparative, or recent-developments questions). By default, fast Runs wait up to 20 seconds to return a terminal Run (200 with status completed, failed or cancelled), while deep Runs and Runs still in progress return 202 with status queued or running and message; pass Prefer: respond-async to return 202 immediately after admission. When status is queued or running, poll GET /v1/research/{id} until status is completed (result holds answer and sources), failed or cancelled. mode defaults to auto (recommended), which routes between fast and deep from the query; fast or deep can be specified when needed.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A matching value is echoed; invalid values are replaced by a UUID.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: RFC 7240 processing preference: respond-async returns 202 immediately after admission; wait=N bounds synchronous waiting to N seconds (capped at 20 seconds).

get.description: Read a Research Run created with the same API key. queued and running are not final: read it again until status is completed, failed or cancelled.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A matching value is echoed; invalid values are replaced by a UUID.

delete.description: Delete a Research Run created with the same API key. Returns 204 once deleted; a Run that is still running is cancelled first and returns 202 with the Run until deletion completes.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A matching value is echoed; invalid values are replaced by a UUID.

post.description: Cancel a queued or running Research Run created with the same API key. 202 means cancellation is still in progress; run_not_cancellable means the Run already ended.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A matching value is echoed; invalid values are replaced by a UUID.

X-Request-Id.description: Echoed valid request ID, otherwise a fresh UUID; also error.request_id.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Authenticated request window limit. May be omitted.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the window. May be omitted.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Integer seconds until the request window resets. May be omitted.

Location.description: Canonical resource path for the created or polled Run.

Preference-Applied.description: Echoed RFC 7240 preference applied by the server (respond-async or wait=N).

Retry-After.description: Delta seconds before retrying on 429 or 503; may also indicate an asynchronous polling interval.

query.description: Search query used to find matching web pages.

published_after.description: Optional UTC ISO 8601 date-time lower bound (for example 2026-09-21T00:00:00Z).

published_before.description: Optional UTC ISO 8601 date-time upper bound (for example 2026-10-21T23:59:59Z).

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL without username or password.

query.description: Complete natural-language question or research topic (including all compared entities, context, and constraints) to answer with cited web sources.

mode.description: Defaults to auto (leave unset for both simple and complex questions). Set fast or deep when the user's prompt explicitly requests fast or deep mode.

message.description: Informational English polling guidance present when status is queued or running; omitted on terminal states. Clients branch on status rather than parsing this text.
